xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"><ns2:id>1ba81872-b58c-4bd8-8dba-60a7cf877f0f</ns2:id><ns2:layoutItemId>CustomHTML1</ns2:layoutItemId><ns2:configData><ns2:id>4e03d446-24d4-479c-8ba3-58625905104c</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@customHTML.contentType</ns2:optionName><ns2:value>TEXT</ns2:value></ns2:configData><ns2:configData><ns2:id>94bd8091-f180-4edb-8ded-707131415d3a</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@customHTML.textContent</ns2:optionName><ns2:value><style>
/* Main container for tabs */
ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap; /* Allow tabs to wrap onto multiple lines */
    align-items: center;
    padding: 5px;
    border-bottom: 1px solid #ddd;
    background-color: #f8f9fa;
    list-style-type: none; /* Remove default list styling */
    margin: 0;
}

/* Style each tab */
ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs > li {
    /*margin-right: 5px;*/
    margin-bottom: 2px;
    list-style-type: none; /* Ensure no bullets */
    white-space: nowrap; /* Prevent text wrapping inside each tab */
}

/* Tab anchor styling */
ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs > li > a {
    display: block;
    padding: 5px 5px;
    background-color: #ffffff;
    border: 1px solid #ddd;
    border-radius: 3px;
    color: #006547 !important;
    text-decoration: none;
    transition: background-color 0.3s ease, color 0.3s ease;
    height:26px;
}

/* Active tab and hover state */
ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs > li.active > a,
ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs > li > a:hover {
    background-color: #007bff;
    color:#333;
}

/* Hide the secondary dropdown menu if it exists */
ul.nav.nav-tabs-mnu.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary {
    display: none !important;
}

/* Make sure the first <ul> doesn't get altered by dropdown behavior */
ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs .dropdown-toggle {
    display: none !important;
}

ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs .dropdown-menu {
    display: none !important;
}

/* Responsive adjustments to ensure tabs wrap correctly */
@media (max-width: 768px) {
    ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs {
        flex-direction: row;
        flex-wrap: wrap; /* Ensure tabs wrap on small screens */
    }

    ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs > li {
        margin-right: 0;
        white-space: normal; /* Allow text to wrap within tabs */
    }

    ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs > li > a {
        text-align: center; /* Center text within tabs */
       /*color: #006547 !important;*/
    }
}
/* Ensure tabs don't leave white space when removed */
ul.nav.nav-tabs.nav-tabs-strip.nav-tabs-simple.tabs-primary.tab-btn-xs > li.hidden {
    display: none !important;
}
/* Ensure all tabs are displayed */
.nav-tabs > li {
    display: inline-block !important; /* Override any display:none */
    visibility: visible !important; /* Ensure visibility */
}
</style></ns2:value></ns2:configData></ns2:layoutItem><ns2:layoutItem xsi:type="ns2:ViewRef" version="8550" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"><ns2:id>bd85072d-7c74-4d39-8ce1-037a06009e0d</ns2:id><ns2:layoutItemId>Header_View1</ns2:layoutItemId><ns2:configData><ns2:id>9b5f4bc3-8427-4832-852a-c8f48faf98dd</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@label</ns2:optionName><ns2:value>Header View</ns2:value></ns2:configData><ns2:configData><ns2:id>de5c6869-6947-4e71-8962-b6bcabb8da57</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@helpText</ns2:optionName><ns2:value></ns2:value></ns2:configData><ns2:configData><ns2:id>716e5467-6ca2-436c-8542-6799aa48ff5f</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@labelVisibility</ns2:optionName><ns2:value>SHOW</ns2:value></ns2:configData><ns2:viewUUID>64.55afafe5-9321-40fd-9b9a-cbbd556a8005</ns2:viewUUID><ns2:binding>tw.businessData.appinfo</ns2:binding></ns2:layoutItem><ns2:layoutItem xsi:type="ns2:CustomHTML" version="8550" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"><ns2:id>51d2a230-d860-4461-8906-45e1e043f082</ns2:id><ns2:layoutItemId>CustomHTML2</ns2:layoutItemId><ns2:configData><ns2:id>2c25bf6a-5e6a-4d24-8174-ad06d5fed4f5</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@customHTML.contentType</ns2:optionName><ns2:value>TEXT</ns2:value></ns2:configData><ns2:configData><ns2:id>5b9bd4fe-ae34-4a40-8d78-59b1fc0acefe</ns2:id><ns2:optionName>@customHTML.textContent</ns2:optionName><ns2:value><style>

  .nav.nav-tabs li.active {
    background-color: #c3f580; /* blue */

//    color: inherit; /* inherit li color */

</style>


<script>
  document.querySelectorAll('.nav.nav-tabs li').forEach(tab => {
    tab.addEventListener('click', function () {
      // remove "active" from all tabs
      document.querySelectorAll('.nav.nav-tabs li').forEach(t => {
        t.classList.remove('active');
        t.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'false');
      });

      // add "active" to clicked tab
      this.classList.add('active');
      this.setAttribute('aria-expanded', 'true');
    });
  });
</script>
